issues.jp_before: 資料[しりょう]が足[た]りないので、今日[きょう]の発表[はっぴょう]は{延期[えんき]せざるを得[え]ません|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: English 'Because the materials are not enough' is unnatural.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'We don't have enough materials, so we have no choice but to postpone today's presentation.'

issues.jp_before: 証拠[しょうこ]がこれだけそろっていては、彼[かれ]が犯人[はんにん]だと{考[かんが]えざるを得[え]ない|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: Distractor 考えるまでもない is awkward in this frame and close to 'it is obvious he is the culprit', so it does not clearly fail the English.
issues.action: Replaced the distractor with 考えてもしかたがない (no point thinking about it), which is plainly wrong.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもの進学[しんがく]のために、そろそろ貯金[ちょきん]を{始[はじ]めないわけにはいかない/始[はじ]めざるを得[え]ない|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: English 'I can't not start saving soon' is ungrammatical.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'With my child's education ahead, I can't put off starting to save any longer.'

issues.jp_before: 新[あたら]しいゲームの広告[こうこく]を見[み]ると、つい{買[か]わずにはいられません|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: つい with 〜ずにはいられない is a clumsy collocation (つい goes with 〜てしまう).

issues.jp_before: 美[うつく]しい夕日[ゆうひ]を見[み]て、思[おも]わず写真[しゃしん]を{撮[と]らずにはいられなかった|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: 思わず with 〜ずにはいられない is redundant and unnatural (思わず goes with 〜てしまう).

issues.jp_before: そんな不思議[ふしぎ]な話[はなし]を聞[き]いたら、理由[りゆう]を{聞[き]かずにはいられません|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: The English is in the past hypothetical ('If I heard ... I couldn't help'), but the Japanese is in the present.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'When I hear such a strange story, I can't help asking why.'

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]の努力[どりょく]には、{感心[かんしん]せずにはいられません|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: English 'Her effort is such that I can't help being impressed' is awkward.
issues.action: English rewritten: 'I can't help being impressed by her effort.'

issues.jp_before: 迷惑[めいわく]をかけたことを思[おも]うと、直接[ちょくせつ]{謝[あやま]らずにはいられません|pt-zaruwoenai}。
issues.problem: Distractor 謝らないわけにはいきません (a duty to apologise) is fully natural after causing trouble and fits the meaning, so the item has two right answers.
issues.action: Deleted. Replaced with 迷子[まいご]の子猫[こねこ]が震[ふる]えているのを見[み]て、{抱[だ]きしめずにはいられなかった|pt-zaruwoenai}。, where there is no duty reading.
